snippet.title: Don't Stop The Beat | Official Reveal Trailer | 3–10 Player Multiplayer
snippet.description:
Blend in. Sneak up. Take down the DJ. 🪩

Don't Stop The Beat is a 3–10 player asymmetrical multiplayer game set in a nightclub.

GANG players hide among dancing NPCs to take down the DJ, while the DJ and bodyguards try to spot them and keep the music playing!

Wishlist on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/5239730/Dont_Stop_the_Beat/

Join our Discord for the November 4 playtest details:
https://discord.gg/qwUryeuMWs

Developed and published by Gig Being Inc.

#DontStopTheBeat #IndieGame #Multiplayer
